title: Opponent Breakdown: North Carolina Tar Heels Defense

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Opponent Breakdown: North Carolina Tar Heels Defense
sources.description: Defense is Bill Belichick’s forte, and the North Carolina Tar Heels are benefiting from his expertise this year. For the second straight year, Belichick has his defense ranked in the top 50 in yards per play. His group is being led by his son Brian after his son Steve left the team earlier this season. […]
